create_masked_sequence_generator: create a MaskedSequenceGenerator instance from config with model, length prediction, and target vocabulary
generate_hypotheses_beam_search: generate hypotheses using beam search by calling generate_hypo with a tensors dictionary containing src_tokens and src_lengths
get_beam_ranking_function: get a beam ranking function by passing a BeamRankingAlgorithm enum value to get_beam_ranking_function
prepare_masked_target_for_lengths: prepare masked target tokens and length masks for beam search using prepare_masked_target_for_lengths with beam tensor and vocab indices
quantize_generator_dynamic: quantize the generator model dynamically with per-channel or embedding quantization using quantize_generator
